last.verdict: Record quarter and a raised outlook, offset by a soft Q4 forecast and a CEO change.

reasons.label: Soft Q4 forecast
reasons.text: Q4 revenue guide of $6.80–6.85B had a midpoint just under the $6.85B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Beat and raised year
reasons.text: Revenue rose 13% to $6.76B, and the full-year outlook was raised to $26.58–26.63B.

reasons.label: New CEO surprise
reasons.text: Anil Chakravarthy replaces Shantanu Narayen on Dec. 1; he ran a much smaller unit.

story: Adobe has beaten estimates and raised its outlook for three straight reports, yet fear of AI competition keeps weighing on the stock. It fell about 5–8% after the March report, when the CEO announced he would leave, and again in June after the CFO's exit. This time it ended up 1.4%.
